what_it_measured.text: Salivary Oxytocin Concentrations in Males following Intranasal Administration of Oxytocin: A Double-Blind, Cross-Over Study

dose.text: In the present double-blind cross-over study we investigated the longevity of a single 24 IU dose of intranasal OT measured in saliva in 40 healthy adult males.

endpoint.text: In the present double-blind cross-over study we investigated the longevity of a single 24 IU dose of intranasal OT measured in saliva in 40 healthy adult males.
Mean salivary oxytocin concentrations (pg/ml) at each time point for OT and placebo condition, with reported outcomes of Wilcoxon signed rank test.

reported_results.text: Related-samples Friedman’s two-way analysis of variance revealed a significant difference between samples, χ2(11) = 286.75, p <0.001.
